% Converted, ltx-talk. C-FRAMETITLE workaround: the braced group is NOT a title
% under ltx-talk (it renders as body text and the header bar stays empty), so
% both forms become an explicit \frametitle. Do NOT "fix" this by loading the
% frame-title-arg class option instead -- that breaks \maketitle (C-MAKETITLE).
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard=a-4, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[c]
\frametitle{Objectives}
Body text.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}<1>[c]
\frametitle{Overlay spec ahead of the options bracket}
Body text.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
